prompt.text: Someone asks you to drop the full customer list into a slide for a meeting that is not about those customers. The sheet is marked internal.

choices.label: Paste the whole list
choices.debrief: The meeting did not need the names, the numbers, or the notes.
choices.report: A full customer list went into a slide.
choices.voice_line: You pasted the whole list into a deck that did not need it.

fallout.text: The deck is forwarded to a partner. The customer list goes with it.

choices.label: Ask the data owner what the meeting is allowed to see
choices.debrief: The mark on the sheet is an instruction, not a suggestion.
choices.report: The list stayed put until the owner answered.
choices.voice_line: You asked the owner of the list before you copied it.

choices.label: Paste the count, not the names
choices.debrief: A count is safer than the list, and you still decided alone.
choices.report: Names stayed out. The owner was not asked.
choices.voice_line: You pasted a count instead of the names, without asking.

fallout.text: The count is quoted back at you by someone who was not in the meeting.
